summary: Unprotected writes must not retry or fail over to another source after an ambiguous transport or server failure; bounded rate-limit recovery remains available.
reason: Mirror sources may share state, so retrying a failed write against another source can duplicate a mutation that already committed. Explicit read-only POST requests retain safe retry and failover behavior.
validated_outcome: Synthetic-transport tests distinguish write transport/503 failure, read-only POST failover, and write 429 recovery.
